newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon lowers rates on weekly CDs.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon lowers rates on weekly CDs.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon lowered interest rates on Thursday on its certificates of deposit for the second time in two weeks.
It reduced rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs to 12.25 percent and 13.00 percent respectively from 12.50 and 13.25 last week.
The previous reduction was on October 31 when the Bank cut the CD rates from 12.75 percent and 13.5 percent respectively.
Thursday's weekly CD issue dated November 15 raised seven billion Lebanese pounds compared with 15 billion last week.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth four billion pounds compared with 11 billion last week and 60-day CDs worth three billion pounds compared with four billion last week.
